summary: There's a part of you that knows you swing between deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a fast, restless mind, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you read people and care on instinct; other days you overthink it, or talk when you should feel. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: There's a part of you that knows you swing between deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a fast, restless mind, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you read people and care on instinct; other days you overthink it, or talk when you should feel. The work is holding both without picking a side. Communication colored by mood; powerful when feeling and reasoning are integrated. Feelings may need language here. Care can become easier to understand when emotion has a way to be named, shared, or talked through.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you think and talk your way through anything.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need — or you overthink it, or talk when you should feel.
integration: Let emotional needs and thinking and speech cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Communication colored by mood; powerful when feeling and reasoning are integrated.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you read people and you think work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
